condition.trigger_context: Generating landing page sections, content marketing markdown, or user-facing copy text blocks.
condition.pattern_signature: Frequent usage of high-contrast color meshes, mesh-gradient text styling, multi-emoji bullet clusters, or text introductions containing clichés like 'In the fast-paced digital landscape' or 'delve deeper'.

directive.actionable_instruction: Enforce minimalist typography frameworks. Prohibit rainbow/mesh gradient hero text; utilize uniform solid weights (#0f172a or #ffffff) with crisp tracking constraints. Ban multi-emoji headers. Maximize professional vocabulary density by stripping repetitive filler adverbs.
directive.explanation: Human aesthetic evaluations reject generic machine-generated design motifs ('AI Slop'). Enforcing high-contrast solid typography limits visual fatigue and improves human trust markers.

validation_proof.test_case_scenario: Refactoring an internationalized product landing page hero configuration.
validation_proof.before_metric_or_output: Delving Into the Future of AI Paradigm Shifts! 🚀✨🔥
validation_proof.after_metric_or_output: Software built for deployment.
validation_proof.empirical_utility_delta: Reduced structural parsing complexity, established verified compliance with brand styling manuals, and passed zero-slop human validation metrics.
